Name: Elliott Gender-Non Conforming Mod
Author: InkstainedPrairie
Description:
Simple Content Patcher mod that makes Elliott GNC! Inspired by my friend's headcanon :D

Not everything has been tested, but it currently includes an updated outfit to include a skirt and some edited dialogue. Unfortunately my skills are lacking so I can't fix the wedding sequence. According to Lewis Elliott is still your husband :(

Portraits are configurable! Highly recommend GMCM for that



Has compatibility with Realistic Writer Elliott and Please, Remember My Marriage
Generic Mod Config Menu reccomended

Please let me know if you find any bugs or issues at https://github.com/InkstainedPrairie/Elliot-GNC-Mod/issues

I'm working on a seasonal version as you read this!

BIG BIG BIG THANKS to AirynS for helping so much with code and doing basically everything for the 1.1.0 update!!!
